_about: Firm-reported payout totals and payout-proof channels as shown on each firm's own homepage. These are the firms' own marketing figures, not audited by PropAnalyse. 'value_usd' is the lower bound of the stated figure. Checked 2026-10-31. 'evidence_type' is 'on-chain' when the firm publishes a payout ledger whose sample transactions we opened on a block explorer; otherwise the figure is self-reported.

fundedxyz.proof: Public on-chain payout ledger: each withdrawal is listed with a USDT (BEP-20) transaction hash linking to BscScan. We opened 5 sample hashes on bscscan.com on 31 Oct 2026: all settled, with amounts and dates matching the ledger. FundedXyz is run by the team behind PropAnalyse.

caveats: The total and the payout count are the firm's own ledger figures. We checked a sample of transactions, not every row.
All sampled transfers come from an address BscScan labels 'Bybit: Wallet 17', an exchange hot wallet. The chain proves each transfer happened as listed; it does not by itself prove who initiated it.
Only page 1 of the ledger shows full hashes; older rows are partly masked. The newest row at our check was dated 13 Jun 2026.
Some ledger rows share one transaction hash (one on-chain transfer covering several payout UIDs); in the two cases we checked, the row amounts add up to the on-chain amount.
